parts.label: (b)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text: Answer: $E(X)=2\times\frac1{36}+3\times\frac4{36}+4\times\frac{10}{36}+5\times\frac{12}{36}+6\times\frac9{36}=\frac{14}{3}$, or $\frac{2+12+40+60+54}{36}=4.67$. Marks: M1. Guidance: accept an unsimplified expression or sum of fractions; may be calculated in the variance; FT their table with five probabilities summing to $0.999\le\text{total}\le1$, $0<p<1$. Answer: $\operatorname{Var}(X)=2^2\frac1{36}+3^2\frac4{36}+4^2\frac{10}{36}+5^2\frac{12}{36}+6^2\frac9{36}-(\frac{14}{3})^2$. Marks: M1. Guidance: appropriate variance formula using their $[E(X)]^2$; FT their table with four or more probabilities, $0<p<1$, which need not sum to 1. If the table is correct, $\frac{824}{36}-\frac{196}{9}$, $\frac{206}{9}-\frac{196}{9}$, $22.89-21.78$, or $(\frac{14}{3})^2$ in the appropriate variance expression implies M1. Answer: $10/9$. Marks: A1. Guidance: accept $1\frac19$, 1.111..., or $1.\dot1$. Total: 3.
